subject: Approval request: endorsement attribution & badge licensing
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex@harborhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: include quote + logo on Redwood case page

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the great pilot support — our team is finalizing a short customer highlight for our site and would love to include a 1-2 sentence quote from HarborHealth and use our logo badge on the Redwood case study page.

Attached is a quick draft of the proposed quote and a mockup of the quote card (harborhealth-quote-draft.docx). We would prefer the byline to read: "Alex Gomez, Director of Data & Analytics, HarborHealth" and for attribution to appear under the quote.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood confirm the exact logo asset we should use and any trademark attribution text you require?
- Do you need legal signoff on a short permission form from us? I can loop in our legal counsel.

Appreciate the help — happy to adjust wording.

Best,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Director, Data & Analytics
HarborHealth

---
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: include quote + logo on Redwood case page

Hi Alex — thanks for sending this over and congrats to the team on the rollout.

Quick notes:
- The quote looks great but we usually tighten language to a single sentence for the quote card. Suggest: "Redwood Inference helped HarborHealth reduce inference latency by 6x while cutting per-token cost by 40% — enabling near-real-time clinical insights." Let me know if that reads true.
- For logos, we prefer a square color and a monochrome white-on-dark variant for badges. Vanessa will attach the brand usage guidelines and a small redline suggestion.
- We do need a short written permission from HarborHealth legal that allows Redwood to publish the quote and a logo on marketing channels (website, social). If you can include Sarah Lin from legal that would be ideal.

Cc'ing Vanessa (comms) and Monica (legal ops) to expedite. If you’re good with the tightened copy, can you confirm and then have legal send a note or e-signed permission? We can also provide a short permission template if your legal team prefers.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Alex Gomez <alex@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: include quote + logo on Redwood case page

Alex / team — adding the updated copy and a couple of small layout notes. I attached a redline (harborhealth-quote-redline.docx) and a preview of the badge placement.

Edit suggestions in the redline: shorten to the single-sentence version Sofia proposed; move the byline under the quote in 12pt italics; please confirm Alex that the byline is OK.

Brand/legal notes for external partners:
- Use the full color logo for light backgrounds only; use the white variant inside colored hero areas.
- Include the trademark line: "HarborHealth is a registered trademark of HarborHealth, Inc. Used with permission."
- Logo file names in the pack: harborhealth_logo_color.svg, harborhealth_logo_white.svg.

Monica — can you confirm whether the standard marketing permission template will be sufficient for HarborHealth, or if we need a custom clause for long-form case studies?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Communications & Content
Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

---
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Alex Gomez <alex@harborhealth.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@harborhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: include quote + logo on Redwood case page

Hi all — looping in legal counsel for HarborHealth (thanks Sarah).

We reviewed the redline and the suggested quote. Our standard marketing permission is attached as a DocuSign link; it authorizes short quotes, logos on marketing channels (web, social, events), and a one-line attribution. It does not transfer any IP. If HarborHealth is comfortable, Sarah can sign or approve with a brief email.

If HarborHealth prefers, we can add the following sentence to the permission clause: "HarborHealth retains the right to review and approve final copy and artwork prior to publication." Let us know which option you prefer.

Attaching logo pack for final placement (harborhealth-logo-pack.zip).

Best,
Monica Patel
Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Alex Gomez <alex@harborhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin (Legal) <sarah.lin@harborhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: include quote + logo on Redwood case page

Thanks everyone — Sarah and I reviewed and we’re good with the tightened quote and the standard marketing permission (please include the approval clause Monica suggested about pre-publication review). Sarah has e-signed the DocuSign and attached the signed permission (harborhealth-permission-signed.pdf). We confirm the byline as: "Alex Gomez, Director of Data & Analytics, HarborHealth" and the logo files you provided are correct.

We’re excited to see the page. Please share staging link before publish.

Best,
Alex
